bio: Research Background Contact Us Rachel joined Boston Children's Hospital in 2022 as a biostatistician in the Biostatistics and Research Design Center in the Institutional Centers of Clinical and Translational Research. At BCH, she is dedicated and determined to make a difference by collaborating with medical professionals and implementing statistical knowledge on various topics. She earned a Master of Biostatistics degree from Duke University in 2022 and a BS in Statistics and Mathematics from the University of South Carolina in 2020.
